name: 抽奖工具 · 抽奖活动创建助手
examples_zh: 我要做个万圣节抽奖，奖品是糖果礼盒和电影票，帮我想想怎么安排。
新店开业想送些小礼物给顾客，帮我设计一个抽奖活动。
想让群里的朋友带朋友一起来抽奖，奖品是咖啡杯，怎么做比较合适？
examples_en: I want to run a Halloween giveaway with candy gift boxes and movie tickets. How should I set it up?
I'm opening a new store and want to give customers some small gifts. Help me plan a giveaway.
I want people in my group to invite friends to a giveaway for coffee mugs. What would work well?
description_zh: 把日常抽奖需求对应到开奖方式、参与条件、好友裂变和额外抽奖机会；用抽奖工具策划、预览、创建微信小程序活动，并查询和导出本人活动数据。
description_en: Map everyday lottery needs to draw modes, entry conditions, invite rewards, and bonus chances; plan, create, query, and export LottoTool activities.
